figures.caption: Fig. 2. The hierarchical structure of the dataset, consisting of 4 major categories and 20 subcategories.
Fig. 3. The experimental paradigm. Each block contains 50 trials with a prepare-watchrecall structure.

Table 3. State validation accuracy (%; mean ± SD across 20 participants), with fullband inputs and alpha ablation. Score selection follows Table 1. ∆ is the full-minusablated mean difference in percentage points, computed before rounding.

Fig. 4. Perception (blue) and recall (orange) across semantic and meta-feature tasks. Bars show mean best validation accuracy; error bars show SD across 20 participants after averaging sessions. Similar bars do not establish statistical equivalence.

Fig. 5. Mean sensor-level validation accuracy for the ‘Human’ meta-feature during perception and recall, using a shared single-channel Conformer and a common color scale. Values are averaged across sessions and participants; no spatial significance is implied.
